record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: For the Hénon divisibility sequence a_n attached to a non-periodic point of a generalized Hénon map over a number field, under what conditions does log Norm(a_n)=o(d^n) as n→∞, and under what conditions does there exist an ideal b such that a_n divides b for infinitely many n?

evidence.quote: Question 46. — Under what circumstance is it true that log Norm(an) = o(dn) as n → ∞? Under what circumstance does there exist an ideal b ⊂ OK,S such that an|b for infinitely many n?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a number field with ring of integers $\mathcal{O}_K$, let $S$ be a finite set of places of $K$ containing all archimedean places, and let $\mathcal{O}_{K,S}$ denote the ring of $S$-integers. A generalized Hénon map of degree $d \geq 2$ is a polynomial automorphism $f : \mathbb{A}^2 \to \mathbb{A}^2$ defined over $K$ of the form
$$ f(x,y) = (y,\, p(y) - \delta x), \qquad p(y) \in K[y],\ \deg p = d,\ \delta \in K^\times,$$
or a composition of such maps, viewed as acting on $\mathbb{A}^2(\overline{K})$. Fix a point $P_0 \in \mathbb{A}^2(K)$ that is not periodic for $f$, and assume that the forward orbit $\{f^n(P_0)\}_{n \geq 0}$ lies in $\mathbb{A}^2(\mathcal{O}_{K,S})$ (after a suitable choice of $S$). Write $f^n(P_0) = (x_n, y_n) \in \mathcal{O}_{K,S}^2$ and, for a chosen nonzero coordinate function (or a chosen base point $Q$), define the associated Hénon divisibility sequence by
$$ \mathfrak{a}_n := \text{ the } \mathcal{O}_{K,S}\text{-ideal generated by the coordinate of } f^n(P_0) - Q,$$
so that $(\mathfrak{a}_n)_{n \geq 1}$ is a sequence of integral ideals of $\mathcal{O}_{K,S}$.

Answer the following two questions:

(a) Under what conditions on $f$, $K$, $S$, and $P_0$ does one have
$$ \log \operatorname{Norm}_{K/\mathbb{Q}}(\mathfrak{a}_n) = o(d^n) \quad \text{as } n \to \infty\,?$$

(b) Under what conditions does there exist a nonzero ideal $\mathfrak{b} \subset \mathcal{O}_{K,S}$ such that $\mathfrak{a}_n \mid \mathfrak{b}$ for infinitely many $n$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a recent list of open problems on Hénon maps (December 2023). A web search did not return any subsequent paper resolving the growth condition log Norm(a_n) = o(d^n) or the bounded-divisor condition for Hénon divisibility sequences, so the problem appears to remain open.
